description: Documentation schema for WatchdogVPN Phase 23.7.5 compatibility manifest. Runtime bootstrap validation is implemented in tools/compat_read.py using only Python stdlib.
title: WatchdogVPN Compatibility Manifest

schema_version.description: Semantic version. Unknown major versions are rejected by the bootstrap reader.

technical_families.description: Technical adapter/package-manager paths. They do not imply support for every derivative.

distributions.description: Concrete distributions. Each declares its own stable or rolling policy.

releases.description: Stable release facts that can feed compat.support_model.StableReleaseFacts without storing calculated classifications.

derivatives.description: Exact derivative mappings. Stable mappings use codenames; rolling lineages do not borrow stable versions.

capabilities.description: Separate core host capabilities and protocol capabilities.

provisioning_methods.description: Reusable method definitions. Selection and execution are later tasks.

protocols.description: Protocol runtime requirements. Each protocol must require at least one protocol capability.

certifications.description: Physical certification records referencing a stable release or rolling snapshot.

validation_metadata.description: Rolling freshness policies, CI refs and manifest-generation metadata.
